en.headline: Local animation Odium Zero holds Hong Kong premiere ahead of cinema screenings
en.dek: The AI-assisted sci-fi work supported by the Cultural and Creative Industries Development Agency screened its extended first episode on Monday, with special screenings starting 7 November.
body: The local premiere of the original animation Odium Zero took place on Monday. The 30-minute extended cut of Episode 1: The Ash Fall will begin special screenings at selected cinemas from 7 November.

Commissioner for Cultural and Creative Industries Drew Lai said at the event that the launch shows positive results from the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government’s efforts to promote the creative industries. Odium Zero is one of the works supported under the third Future Animation – AI-assisted Animation Production Support Scheme run by the Hong Kong Digital Entertainment Association and sponsored by the Cultural and Creative Industries Development Agency.

Written and directed by James Hung, executive produced by Jacky Chu and produced by ORINPIX Studios Limited, the animation depicts an apocalypse triggered by lies. The project had its global launch earlier this year at Hong Kong Comic Con 2026, was screened at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival, and was shortlisted for the 22nd Chinese American Film Festival in Los Angeles. The creative team also operated a local pop-up store last month for the work and related merchandise.

Special screenings of the extended first episode are scheduled at selected venues starting this Friday. The production combines 2D hand-drawn elements with AI-assisted techniques and features a Cantonese voice cast.

zh.headline: 本地動畫《無涯之約》舉行香港首映 11月7日起特別放映
zh.dek: 文創產業發展處支持的人工智能輔助科幻動畫周一首映加長版第一話，本周五起在指定戲院進行特別放映。
body: 本地原創動畫《無涯之約》（Odium Zero）於周一舉行香港首映禮。首集「第一話·灰降」的30分鐘加長版將由11月7日起在指定戲院進行特別放映。
文化體育及旅遊局轄下文創產業發展處處長黎繪虹在活動上表示，作品成功推出顯示香港特區政府推動創意產業發展的積極成果。《無涯之約》是香港數碼娛樂協會主辦、文創產業發展處贊助的第三屆「明日動畫——人工智能輔助動畫製作支援計劃」支持的作品之一。
作品由孔令政編劇及執導、朱漢威監製、ORINPIX Studios Limited製作，講述因謊言引發的末日故事。今年較早時在香港Comic Con 2026全球首映，曾於法國安錫國際動畫電影節放映，並入圍洛杉磯第22屆中美電影節。創作團隊上月亦設本地快閃店推廣作品及相關周邊產品。
加長版第一話的特別放映由本周五起在選定場地進行。製作結合二維手繪與人工智能輔助技術，並以粵語聲演。
